name: project-setup
description: Stand a new app up with the ecosystem's own generator rather than files written from memory, then add the layering a generator leaves out — and prove the boundary check fails when the rule is broken.

skills.name: architecture-apply
skills.line: Add the layering a generator leaves out — boundaries, a composition root, a real test — on top of the tree that actually exists.

skills.name: boundary-prove
skills.line: Prove an architecture check fails when the rule is broken, by planting a violation and running it. BITES, TOOTHLESS or NO-ORACLE.

skills.name: scaffold-run
skills.line: Stand a project up with the ecosystem's own generator and report what actually landed. Never hand-writes a file a generator produces.

skills.name: stack-choose
skills.line: Choose a stack against a brief and this machine, with what every choice costs named. Takes acronyms like MERN apart into the decisions they hide.
